newsitem.title: USA: IBM has licensing deal with ActaMed.
newsitem.headline: IBM has licensing deal with ActaMed.

text.p: ActaMed Corp said Thursday it has reached a technology licensing agreement with International Business Machines Corp.

Under the agreement, IBM will license ActaMed's current "Object Broker" patent and related concepts, ActaMed said. Each company will continue to sell separately their health information network products, it said.
ActaMed has developed a data base structure that creates health information networks. Its product, ActaLink, enables participants to share patient information on a real-time basis.
IBM has been selling ActaLink for almost two years under a marketing tieup between the two companies.
